mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a Jack-and-Jill bathroom remodel in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a Jack-and-Jill bathroom remodel in Berkeley, you will typically need permits for plumbing, electrical, and structural work, especially if you are reconfiguring the layout or making significant changes. The City of Berkeley requires permits for most construction that alters a building's structure, mechanical, plumbing, or electrical systems. Failing to obtain necessary permits can result in fines and remediation. Hometelligent assists clients with navigating the local permitting process in Berkeley to ensure compliance.
